top_signals.title: Dollar Heads for Worst Week in Three Months as Fed Doubts Grow
top_signals.summary: The dollar headed for its worst week in three months on concerns the Federal Reserve won’t move forcefully enough to contain inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Microsoft's Xbox chief lays out plan to pass rivals on margin by 2030 in memo to employees
top_signals.summary: Microsoft's gaming unit wants to invest in its Minecraft franchise and expand through partnerships, including in China.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: The arms race for cheaper anti-ballistic weapons is underway
top_signals.summary: After years of a Patriot monopoly, new anti-ballistic alternatives are emerging. Officials hope to see some of them on the battlefield by the end of 2026.
